seo.title: About RAVU — Membership for Tanzania's riders and vehicle owners
seo.description: RAVU Ltd is a Dar es Salaam company building a membership that cuts insurance, parts and repair costs for riders, drivers and vehicle owners.

hero.title:
We help riders and drivers
spend less on
hero.text: RAVU Ltd is based in Dar es Salaam. We group boda boda riders, Bajaj operators, car owners and fleets into one membership, then agree lower prices with insurers, parts suppliers and garages on their behalf.
hero.image: RAVU Riders at the Service Hub.jpg
hero.imageAlt: RAVU riders at a local motorcycle workshop and service hub

values.title: Protection
values.text: Insurance riders can afford, with simpler sign-up and claims.

values.title: Buying power
values.text: Many small customers get a better price as one group than on their own.

values.title: Lower running costs
values.text: Every shilling saved on parts and cover stays in the rider's pocket.

purpose.title: Why RAVU
purpose.text: Most riders buy insurance and parts on their own at full price, or go without. RAVU puts them in one verified group, so partners can offer lower prices and still win more business.

cards.title: Our Vision
cards.text: A membership every rider, driver and vehicle owner in Tanzania can rely on for cover, parts and repairs.

cards.title: Our Mission
cards.text: Cut the cost of running a vehicle through group discounts, simpler insurance and trusted garages.

cards.title: How we do it
cards.text: Verify members, then bring them to partners as one group. Partners win customers cheaply; members get up to 30% off insurance and up to 25% off parts.

vision.title: From one city
vision.text: We start with a 4–6 month pilot in Dar es Salaam with 200–500 members. If the discounts hold up, this is what comes next:
pillars: Embedded insurance solutions & digital policy management inside the RAVU platform
RAVU-approved service centres and spare parts suppliers nationwide
Commercial Fleet Maintenance Programs & volume-based bulk spare-parts pricing
National Roadside Assistance, Vehicle Inspection & Tire and Battery Programs
Predictable Maintenance Subscription Packages & tier-based rider/driver rewards
Family protection packages, health/life insurance & financial wellness initiatives

quotes: Building a trusted ecosystem that delivers mobility, opportunity, protection, and prosperity for every rider.

We believe that affordable insurance and reliable vehicle maintenance are not only a commercial opportunity, but a social and economic necessity for the communities we serve. Together with our strategic partners, we are lowering operating costs, protecting families, and driving mobility forward across Tanzania.
